source: OWASP WSTG v4 — Information Gathering, Configuration, Identity Management
description: QRadar SIEM alert rules mapped from WSTG-INFO (01), WSTG-CONF (02), WSTG-IDM (03) test catalogs

rules.name: Search Engine Discovery - Sensitive Content Indexed
rules.description: Detects sensitive content indexed by search engines including admin pages, error messages, directory listings, and exposed documents accessible via search operators
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL, username, sourceip, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/admin%' OR URL ILIKE '%/wp-admin%' OR URL ILIKE '%/manager%' OR URL ILIKE '%/console%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' GROUP BY URL, username, sourceip, devicetime LAST 24 HOURS

rules.name: Web Server Version Information Disclosure
rules.description: Detects HTTP Server response headers leaking server software version information (Apache, nginx, IIS) that enables targeted attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, header_value FROM events WHERE (header_name = 'Server' AND (header_value ILIKE '%apache%' OR header_value ILIKE '%nginx%' OR header_value ILIKE '%microsoft-iis%')) AND NOT header_value = 'Server: obfuscated' GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL, header_value LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Robots.txt Sensitive Path Disclosure
rules.description: Detects robots.txt files that disclose sensitive administrative paths and internal URL structures that should not be publicly enumerated
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/robots.txt' AND (payload ILIKE '%admin%' OR payload ILIKE '%/wp-%' OR payload ILIKE '%/backup%' OR payload ILIKE '%/api/%' OR payload ILIKE '%/config%') LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: Application Error Disclosure - Stack Trace in Response
rules.description: Detects application error responses containing stack traces, file paths, database error messages, or internal system information
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%stack trace%' OR payload ILIKE '%NullReferenceException%' OR payload ILIKE '%SQLException%' OR payload ILIKE '%at com.%' OR payload ILIKE '%at org.%' OR payload ILIKE '%/var/www/%' OR payload ILIKE '%C:\inetpub%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Cloud Metadata Endpoint Access Attempt (SSRF)
rules.description: Detects attempts to access cloud instance metadata endpoints (AWS, GCP, Azure) which could lead to credential theft via SSRF
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%169.254.169.254%' OR URL ILIKE '%/latest/meta-data/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/computeMetadata/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/metadata/instance%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Source Code Repository Credential Exposure
rules.description: Detects exposure of hardcoded credentials, API keys, and database connection strings in source code repositories accessible via HTTP
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/.git/config%' OR URL ILIKE '%/.env%' OR URL ILIKE '%/wp-config.php%' OR URL ILIKE '%/config.yml%' OR URL ILIKE '%/database.yml%') AND NOT username IS NULL LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Exposed Elasticsearch or Kibana Instance
rules.description: Detects access to publicly exposed Elasticsearch or Kibana instances that may leak sensitive data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/_cat/indices%' OR URL ILIKE '%/_search%' OR URL ILIKE '%/kibana%' OR URL ILIKE '%:9200/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/app/kibana%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_monitor' LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: MongoDB or Redis Unauthenticated Access
rules.description: Detects connections to MongoDB or Redis instances without authentication on public networks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, destinationport, devicetime FROM events WHERE (destinationport IN (27017, 27018, 6379) AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_app_server') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: GraphQL Introspection Query - Schema Exposure
rules.description: Detects GraphQL introspection queries that expose schema, data types, and available mutations to unauthorized users
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/graphql%' AND (payload ILIKE '%__schema%' OR payload ILIKE '%__type%' OR payload ILIKE '%introspection%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'internal_developer') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Swagger/OpenAPI Documentation Exposure in Production
rules.description: Detects access to Swagger/OpenAPI documentation endpoints in production environments exposing API schemas
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/swagger%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api-docs%' OR URL ILIKE '%/v2/api-docs%' OR URL ILIKE '%/v3/api-docs%' OR URL ILIKE '%/openapi.json%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_developer_subnet' LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: S3 Bucket Public Access Enumeration
rules.description: Detects attempts to enumerate or access public AWS S3 buckets for data leakage
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%.s3.amazonaws.com%' AND (URL ILIKE '%?list-type=2%' OR URL ILIKE '%?prefix=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?max-keys=%') AND NOT sourceip = 'authorized_aws_service' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Terraform State File Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to exposed Terraform state files containing cloud infrastructure secrets and resource configurations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/terraform.tfstate%' OR URL ILIKE '%/terraform.tfstate.backup%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_ci_cd' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: CORS Origin Reflection - Cross-Origin Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects CORS misconfiguration allowing arbitrary origins to access sensitive data across domains
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' AND (header_value ILIKE '%*%' OR header_value ILIKE '%evil%' OR header_value NOT ILIKE '%trusted-domain.com%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_proxy' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Kubernetes API Server Public Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to publicly exposed Kubernetes API servers enabling cluster enumeration and secret theft
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, destinationport, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v1/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v1/namespaces%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v1/secrets%') AND destinationport = 6443 AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'internal_k8s_node') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Environment Configuration File Access (.env)
rules.description: Detects access to environment configuration files containing database credentials, API keys, and secret tokens
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/.env%' OR URL ILIKE '%/.env.local%' OR URL ILIKE '%/.env.production%' OR URL ILIKE '%/.env.bak%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_deployment_server' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Directory Listing Enabled - Sensitive File Exposure
rules.description: Detects HTTP responses with directory listings exposing file structures, backup files, and internal paths
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%Index of /%' OR payload ILIKE '%Directory listing%' OR payload ILIKE '%<title>Index of%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: JavaScript Bundle Hardcoded API Key Detection
rules.description: Detects JavaScript file responses containing hardcoded API keys, secrets, or internal URLs that reveal application structure
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%.js' AND (payload ILIKE '%api_key%' OR payload ILIKE '%apikey%' OR payload ILIKE '%secret_key%' OR payload ILIKE '%AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID%' OR payload ILIKE '%authorization: Bearer%') LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: DNS Zone Transfer Attempt
rules.description: Detects DNS zone transfer attempts that could reveal internal network topology and hostnames
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, devicetime FROM events WHERE devicetime > '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND QIDNAME(QID) ILIKE '%AXFR%' AND eventdirection = 'L2R' GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, devicetime LAST 24 HOURS

rules.name: Backup File Access Attempt
rules.description: Detects access to backup configuration files (.bak, .old, .orig, .swp) that may contain credentials or internal configurations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%.bak' OR URL ILIKE '%.old' OR URL ILIKE '%.orig' OR URL ILIKE '%.swp' OR URL ILIKE '%~%' OR URL ILIKE '%.save%' OR URL ILIKE '%.backup%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_backup_system' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: HTTP Response Header Information Disclosure
rules.description: Detects HTTP responses leaking framework version, backend server, or internal infrastructure details via response headers
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, header_name, header_value FROM events WHERE (header_name IN ('X-Powered-By', 'X-AspNet-Version', 'X-AspNetMvc-Version', 'Server') AND header_value NOT ILIKE '%obfuscated%') AND NOT header_value IS NULL LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Missing Content Security Policy Header
rules.description: Detects HTTP responses missing Content-Security-Policy header which enables XSS and data exfiltration attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL, sourceip, destinationip FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'Content-Security-Policy') GROUP BY URL, sourceip, destinationip LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

rules.name: Missing HSTS Header - HTTP Strict Transport Security
rules.description: Detects HTTPS responses missing HSTS header allowing protocol downgrade and man-in-the-middle attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL, destinationip FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND URL ILIKE 'https://%/' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'Strict-Transport-Security') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Spring Boot Actuator Endpoint Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to Spring Boot Actuator endpoints (/actuator/env, /actuator/health, /actuator/metrics) that may leak environment variables and secrets
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/actuator/env%' OR URL ILIKE '%/actuator/configprops%' OR URL ILIKE '%/actuator/metrics%' OR URL ILIKE '%/actuator/trace%' OR URL ILIKE '%/actuator/beans%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_monitoring' LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Missing HTTP Security Headers Bundle
rules.description: Detects responses missing multiple security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection) simultaneously
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL, COUNT(*) as missing_headers FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (header_name NOT IN ('X-Content-Type-Options', 'X-Frame-Options', 'X-XSS-Protection') OR header_name IS NULL) GROUP BY URL LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

rules.name: Cookie Missing Secure Flag
rules.description: Detects session cookies set without the Secure flag allowing transmission over unencrypted connections
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Set-Cookie' AND header_value NOT ILIKE '%Secure%' AND (header_value ILIKE '%session%' OR header_value ILIKE '%token%' OR header_value ILIKE '%auth%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Cookie Missing HttpOnly Flag
rules.description: Detects session cookies set without the HttpOnly flag allowing JavaScript access to session tokens
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Set-Cookie' AND header_value NOT ILIKE '%HttpOnly%' AND (header_value ILIKE '%session%' OR header_value ILIKE '%token%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Cookie Missing SameSite Attribute
rules.description: Detects session cookies without SameSite attribute making them vulnerable to CSRF attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Set-Cookie' AND header_value NOT ILIKE '%SameSite%' AND (header_value ILIKE '%session%' OR header_value ILIKE '%token%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Debug Mode Enabled in Production
rules.description: Detects application debug mode enabled in production leaking stack traces, variables, and internal state
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%debug=true%' OR payload ILIKE '%APP_DEBUG=true%' OR payload ILIKE '%DEBUG_MODE=1%' OR payload ILIKE '%Django Debug=True%' OR URL ILIKE '%?debug=true%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_developer_subnet' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: TLS Weak Cipher Suite Negotiation
rules.description: Detects TLS connections using weak cipher suites (3DES, RC4, export ciphers) that compromise data encryption
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, devicetime FROM events WHERE QIDNAME(QID) ILIKE '%weak cipher%' OR QIDNAME(QID) ILIKE '%TLS 1.0%' OR QIDNAME(QID) ILIKE '%SSL 3.0%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: CORS Wildcard Origin Configuration
rules.description: Detects Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers set to wildcard (*) allowing any origin to access resources
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' AND header_value = '*' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: HTTP TRACE Method Enabled
rules.description: Detects HTTP TRACE method enabled which allows Cross-Site Tracing (XST) attacks to steal cookies
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, devicetime FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE 'TRACE %' OR header_name = 'Allow' AND header_value ILIKE '%TRACE%') LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: Jenkins CI/CD Pipeline Public Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to publicly exposed Jenkins instances that could leak build secrets, credentials, and pipeline configurations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/jenkins%' OR URL ILIKE '%:8080/job/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/job/%/build%' OR URL ILIKE '%/credentials/store/%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_ci_network' LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Admin Interface Public Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to admin interfaces on production systems that should not be publicly accessible
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/admin%' OR URL ILIKE '%/administrator%' OR URL ILIKE '%/phpmyadmin%' OR URL ILIKE '%/manager/html%' OR URL ILIKE '%/wp-admin%' OR URL ILIKE '%/console%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'internal_admin_subnet') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Cache Control Missing for Sensitive Pages
rules.description: Detects responses with sensitive data that lack Cache-Control: no-store headers, risking data exposure through caching layers
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL, sourceip, destinationip FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/account%' OR URL ILIKE '%/profile%' OR URL ILIKE '%/payment%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'Cache-Control' AND e2.header_value ILIKE '%no-store%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Path Traversal Attempt
rules.description: Detects path traversal attacks using ../ or encoded variants attempting to access files outside web root
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%../%' OR URL ILIKE '%..\%' OR URL ILIKE '%..%2f%' OR URL ILIKE '%..%5c%' OR URL ILIKE '%....//%' OR URL ILIKE '%..%252f%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_scanner' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: JWT Token Without Expiration or Weak Algorithm
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens with 'none' algorithm, missing expiration, or HS256 with weak secrets in authentication flows
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, header_value FROM events WHERE (header_value ILIKE '%eyJ%' AND (header_value ILIKE '%"alg":"none"%' OR header_value ILIKE '%"alg":"None"%')) OR (URL ILIKE '%/auth/token%' AND payload ILIKE '%eyJhbGciOiJub25l%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Subdomain Takeover - CNAME Dangling
rules.description: Detects DNS CNAME records pointing to decommissioned external services that could be taken over
rules.aql_query: SELECT domainname, qname, qtype, rdata FROM events WHERE qtype = 'CNAME' AND (rdata ILIKE '%.s3.amazonaws.com%' OR rdata ILIKE '%.azurewebsites.net%' OR rdata ILIKE '%.herokuapp.com%' OR rdata ILIKE '%.github.io%' OR rdata ILIKE '%.cloudfront.net%') AND NOT domainname ILIKE '%active-service%' LAST 24 HOURS

rules.name: Missing X-Content-Type-Options Header
rules.description: Detects responses missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header allowing MIME-type sniffing attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL, sourceip, destinationip FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'X-Content-Type-Options') LAST 6 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

rules.name: Database Connection String in HTTP Response
rules.description: Detects database connection strings (JDBC, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) leaked in HTTP responses
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%jdbc:%' OR payload ILIKE '%mongodb://%' OR payload ILIKE '%postgresql://%' OR payload ILIKE '%mysql://%' OR payload ILIKE '%Server=%;Database=%;User ID=%;Password=%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Environment Variable Exposure via Actuator or Debug Endpoints
rules.description: Detects environment variable leakage through Spring Boot actuator, /env, or debug endpoints containing secrets
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/actuator/env%' OR URL ILIKE '%/env%' OR URL ILIKE '%/debug%' OR URL ILIKE '%/configprops%') AND (payload ILIKE '%password%' OR payload ILIKE '%secret%' OR payload ILIKE '%api_key%' OR payload ILIKE '%AWS_SECRET%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_monitoring' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: User Enumeration via Login Error Messages
rules.description: Detects login error messages that differentiate between invalid username and invalid password enabling account enumeration
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/login%' AND (payload ILIKE '%user not found%' OR payload ILIKE '%account does not exist%' OR payload ILIKE '%invalid username%' OR payload ILIKE '%email not registered%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' GROUP BY sourceip HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Account Enumeration via Password Reset Timing
rules.description: Detects timing-based account enumeration through password reset endpoints by analyzing response time differentials
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime, LONG(eventduration) as duration FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/reset-password%' OR URL ILIKE '%/forgot-password%' GROUP BY sourceip, URL, duration LAST 1 HOURS HAVING STDDEV(duration) > 500

rules.name: PII Leakage in API User Profile Responses
rules.description: Detects API responses containing PII fields (SSN, email, phone) returned without proper authorization or masking
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/profile/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%ssn%' OR payload ILIKE '%social_security%' OR payload ILIKE '%date_of_birth%' OR payload ILIKE '%passport_number%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_authorized_service' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Cross-Tenant Identity Data Access
rules.description: Detects cross-tenant data access attempts in multi-tenant applications through IDOR or privilege escalation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/tenants/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/orgs/%') AND username IS NOT NULL AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_service_account' GROUP BY sourceip, username, URL LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT URL) > 5

rules.name: OAuth Scope Over-Privilege Detection
rules.description: Detects OAuth token usage with scopes exceeding the authorized scope for the user's role
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Authorization' AND header_value ILIKE 'Bearer %' AND (header_value ILIKE '%scope=admin%' OR header_value ILIKE '%scope=superuser%' OR header_value ILIKE '%scope=delete_all%') AND NOT username IN (SELECT username FROM REFERENCE_SET WHERE type = 'admin_users') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: SCIM Provisioning Endpoint Unauthorized Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to SCIM user provisioning endpoints that could create or modify identity data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/scim/v2/Users%' OR URL ILIKE '%/scim/v2/Groups%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'identity_provider') LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Password Hash Exposure in API Response
rules.description: Detects API responses containing password hashes, salts, or authentication secrets in cleartext or weak hash format
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%$2a$%' OR payload ILIKE '%$2b$%' OR payload ILIKE '%$2y$%' OR payload ILIKE '%$6$%' OR payload ILIKE '%sha256:%' OR payload ILIKE '%md5:%' OR payload ILIKE '%"password_hash":%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: GraphQL User Data Depth Attack
rules.description: Detects GraphQL queries with excessive depth targeting user/identity data for mass extraction
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/graphql%' AND (payload ILIKE '%user%' OR payload ILIKE '%account%') AND LENGTH(payload) > 2000 GROUP BY sourceip LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

rules.name: Bulk User Export or Download Anomaly
rules.description: Detects bulk export or download of user data exceeding normal thresholds, indicating data exfiltration
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/export%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/download%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users.csv%' OR URL ILIKE '%/admin/users?format=%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 24 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

rules.name: Account Deletion Without Data Anonymization Verification
rules.description: Detects account deletion requests without corresponding data anonymization events, indicating potential PII retention violations
rules.aql_query: SELECT username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/delete%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/account/delete%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.username = events.username AND e2.URL ILIKE '%/anonymize%') LAST 24 HOURS

rules.name: Exposed Docker Registry or Container Image
rules.description: Detects access to exposed Docker registry v2 API allowing image enumeration and potential secret extraction from container layers
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/v2/_catalog%' OR URL ILIKE '%/v2/%/tags/list%' OR URL ILIKE '%:5000/v2/%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_ci_cd' LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Firebase Database Public Read Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized read access to Firebase Realtime Database or Firestore instances without authentication
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%.firebaseio.com/%' OR URL ILIKE '%firestore.googleapis.com/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'authorized_firebase_client') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Source Map File Exposure - Source Code Recovery
rules.description: Detects access to JavaScript source map files that reveal original source code structure and comments
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%.map' OR URL ILIKE '%.js.map%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_developer_subnet' LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: Grafana or Kibana Dashboard Public Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to publicly exposed Grafana or Kibana dashboards leaking infrastructure metrics and business data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/grafana/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/kibana/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:3000/%' OR URL ILIKE '%:5601/%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'internal_monitoring') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Postman Collection Public Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to publicly shared Postman collections containing API endpoints and authentication tokens
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%postman.com/collections/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/postman/%' OR URL ILIKE '%.postman_collection.json%') LAST 24 HOURS

rules.name: Content-Disposition Header Missing on Download
rules.description: Detects file download responses missing Content-Disposition: attachment header allowing inline rendering of malicious files
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL, sourceip FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND (URL ILIKE '%.pdf%' OR URL ILIKE '%.doc%' OR URL ILIKE '%.xls%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'Content-Disposition' AND e2.header_value ILIKE '%attachment%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Azure Blob Container Public Access
rules.description: Detects access to Azure Blob Storage containers with public read access enabled
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, devicetime FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%.blob.core.windows.net/%' OR URL ILIKE '%.blob.core.windows.net/%container%') AND NOT sourceip = 'authorized_azure_service' LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: Docker Compose File Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to docker-compose.yml files exposing internal service topology, credentials, and network configuration
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/docker-compose.yml%' OR URL ILIKE '%/docker-compose.yaml%' OR URL ILIKE '%/compose/compose-file%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_developer_subnet' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: JWT Token Exposed in URL Query Parameter
rules.description: Detects JWT or session tokens passed in URL query parameters vulnerable to logging and referrer leakage
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%?token=eyJ%' OR URL ILIKE '%?access_token=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?session_id=%' OR URL ILIKE '%?auth=%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: X-Frame-Options Missing - Clickjacking Risk
rules.description: Detects responses missing X-Frame-Options header allowing the page to be embedded in frames for clickjacking attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'X-Frame-Options') AND (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/transfer%' OR URL ILIKE '%/payment%' OR URL ILIKE '%/settings%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: SAML Assertion PII Exposure
rules.description: Detects SAML assertions containing excessive PII fields beyond what is required for the service provider
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%samlp:Response%' OR payload ILIKE '%saml:Assertion%') AND (payload ILIKE '%ssn%' OR payload ILIKE '%passport%' OR payload ILIKE '%date_of_birth%' OR payload ILIKE '%address%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: User Search and Filter Endpoint Mass Data Query
rules.description: Detects mass user data queries through search/filter API endpoints exceeding normal thresholds
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users?%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/search%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_admin_service' GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 50

rules.name: LDAP Query Anomaly - Excessive Attribute Retrieval
rules.description: Detects LDAP queries requesting excessive attributes including PII fields, indicating potential data harvesting
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, payload FROM events WHERE payload ILIKE '%LDAP%' AND (payload ILIKE '%(&(objectClass=%' OR payload ILIKE '%mail=%' OR payload ILIKE '%telephoneNumber=%' OR payload ILIKE '%socialSecurityNumber=%') GROUP BY sourceip LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

rules.name: MFA Configuration Data Exposure
rules.description: Detects API responses exposing MFA configuration details (TOTP seeds, backup codes) in cleartext
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/mfa/setup%' OR URL ILIKE '%/2fa/configure%') AND (payload ILIKE '%secret=%' OR payload ILIKE '%backup_codes%' OR payload ILIKE '%qr_code%') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' LAST 30 MINUTES

rules.name: Identity Data Access Logging Gap
rules.description: Detects identity data access events that lack corresponding audit log entries, indicating logging gaps for PII access
rules.aql_query: SELECT username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/profile/%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.username = events.username AND e2.URL ILIKE '%/audit/log%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Google Dorking for Exposed Database Dump Files
rules.description: Detects HTTP requests matching Google dork patterns that target exposed database dump files (SQL dumps, CSV exports, backup archives)
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%.sql%' OR URL ILIKE '%.dump%' OR URL ILIKE '%backup.tar%' OR URL ILIKE '%database.csv%' OR URL ILIKE '%.bak%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'internal_backup') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: AWS Lambda Environment Variable Credential Exposure
rules.description: Detects Lambda function invocations or configurations that may expose environment variables containing credentials
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%lambda.amazonaws.com%' OR URL ILIKE '%/2015-03-31/functions/%') AND (payload ILIKE '%environment%' OR payload ILIKE '%AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY%' OR payload ILIKE '%DATABASE_URL%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: APK/IPA Secret Hardcoded Extraction
rules.description: Detects mobile application binary download requests from non-standard sources that may contain hardcoded API keys and secrets
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%.apk%' OR URL ILIKE '%.ipa%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'app_store_cdn') LAST 24 HOURS

rules.name: HTTP Referrer Header Leakage of Sensitive Parameters
rules.description: Detects Referrer headers containing sensitive URL parameters (tokens, session IDs, PII) being sent to external domains
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Referer' AND (header_value ILIKE '%token=%' OR header_value ILIKE '%session_id=%' OR header_value ILIKE '%ssn=%' OR header_value ILIKE '%api_key=%') AND NOT destinationip ILIKE '%internal-domain.com%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: WebSocket Sensitive Data Transmission Without Encryption
rules.description: Detects WebSocket connections transmitting potentially sensitive data without proper encryption verification
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE 'ws://%' AND NOT URL ILIKE 'wss://%' AND (destinationport = 80 OR destinationport = 8080) LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Feature Policy Missing - Browser Data Access Control
rules.description: Detects responses missing Permissions-Policy header allowing unrestricted browser feature access (camera, microphone, geolocation)
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'Permissions-Policy') LAST 6 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

rules.name: TLS Certificate Expiring Within 30 Days
rules.description: Detects TLS certificates expiring within 30 days that could lead to service disruption or security bypass
rules.aql_query: SELECT destinationip, devicetime FROM events WHERE QIDNAME(QID) ILIKE '%certificate expiring%' AND LONG(devicetime) < LONG(NOW() + 30 DAYS) AND NOT QIDNAME(QID) IS NULL LAST 24 HOURS

rules.name: Referrer Policy Missing or Permissive
rules.description: Detects responses with missing or permissive Referrer-Policy headers allowing URL leakage to third-party sites
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL FROM events WHERE eventdirection = 'L2R' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'Referrer-Policy' AND e2.header_value NOT ILIKE '%no-referrer%') LAST 6 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

rules.name: Data Masking Failure in Error Responses
rules.description: Detects error responses containing unmasked PII or sensitive data that should have been sanitized
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%SQLException%' OR payload ILIKE '%Stacktrace%' OR payload ILIKE '%Internal Server Error%') AND (payload ILIKE '%@%.com%' OR payload ILIKE '%SSN%' OR payload ILIKE '%credit card%' OR payload ILIKE '%password=%') LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Redis Unauthenticated Access on Public Network
rules.description: Detects connections to Redis instances without authentication from external sources on public networks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, destinationport FROM events WHERE destinationport = 6379 AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'internal_app_server') AND eventdirection = 'L2R' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Identity Data Export Volume Anomaly
rules.description: Detects anomalous volume of identity data exports indicating potential data exfiltration or compliance violation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, LONG(SUM(events.bytes)) as total_bytes FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/export%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/identity/download%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 24 HOURS HAVING total_bytes > 10485760

rules.name: Data Subject Access Request Endpoint Anomaly
rules.description: Detects anomalous patterns in data subject access request (DSAR) endpoints indicating potential abuse or DDoS
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/privacy/request%' OR URL ILIKE '%/dsar%' OR URL ILIKE '%/gdpr/request%' OR URL ILIKE '%/data-subject/%') GROUP BY sourceip LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 20

rules.name: Identity Provider Federation Metadata Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to SAML/OIDC federation metadata endpoints that expose trust relationships and identity provider configuration
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/FederationMetadata%' OR URL ILIKE '%/.well-known/openid-configuration%' OR URL ILIKE '%/.well-known/webfinger%' OR URL ILIKE '%/saml/metadata%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_identity_provider' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Consent and Privacy Preference Manipulation
rules.description: Detects unusual patterns of privacy preference changes that may indicate consent manipulation or privacy bypass attempts
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/consent%' OR URL ILIKE '%/privacy/preferences%' OR URL ILIKE '%/opt-out%') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 24 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

rules.name: Multi-Tenant Identity Data Isolation Failure
rules.description: Detects cross-tenant identity data access patterns indicating multi-tenant isolation failures
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/tenants/%/users%' OR URL ILIKE '%/organizations/%/members%') AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'internal_service') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT URL) > 3

rules.name: CloudFront Distribution Origin Server Exposure
rules.description: Detects requests directly to origin servers bypassing CloudFront, indicating potential origin server disclosure
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%X-Cache: MISS%' OR header_name = 'X-Amz-Cf-Id') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'X-Cache') AND NOT sourceip = 'cloudfront_edge' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: API Documentation Endpoint Discovery
rules.description: Detects access to API documentation endpoints (Swagger, OpenAPI, GraphQL schema) from unauthorized sources
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/swagger-ui%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api-docs%' OR URL ILIKE '%/openapi.json%' OR URL ILIKE '%/graphql?query=%' OR URL ILIKE '%/.well-known/schema-discovery%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_developer_subnet' LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: DigitalOcean Spaces or Linode Object Storage Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to publicly exposed DigitalOcean Spaces or Linode object storage containing sensitive data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%.digitaloceanspaces.com/%' OR URL ILIKE '%.linodeobjects.com/%' OR URL ILIKE '%.l.objects.linode.com/%') AND NOT sourceip = 'authorized_service' LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: Data Residency Header Violation
rules.description: Detects data transfers that violate data residency requirements indicated by missing or incorrect geo-routing headers
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/data%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name ILIKE '%x-data-residency%') AND destinationip NOT ILIKE '%eu-west%' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: CSP Report URI Data Exfiltration Monitoring
rules.description: Detects Content Security Policy violation reports indicating potential data exfiltration attempts via CSP-connected sources
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/csp-report%' AND (payload ILIKE '%connect-src%' OR payload ILIKE '%form-action%' OR payload ILIKE '%script-src%') GROUP BY sourceip LAST 1 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

rules.name: CORS Allow-Headers Sensitive Header Exposure
rules.description: Detects CORS configurations exposing sensitive response headers (Authorization, X-CSRF-Token) to unauthorized origins
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Access-Control-Expose-Headers' AND (header_value ILIKE '%authorization%' OR header_value ILIKE '%x-csrf%' OR header_value ILIKE '%x-api-key%' OR header_value ILIKE '%cookie%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Subresource Integrity Missing for Third-Party Scripts
rules.description: Detects third-party JavaScript includes without SRI (Subresource Integrity) hashes enabling supply chain attacks
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE payload ILIKE '%<script src=%' AND (payload ILIKE '%cdn.%' OR payload ILIKE '%googleapis.com%' OR payload ILIKE '%cloudflare.com%') AND NOT payload ILIKE '%integrity=%' LAST 6 HOURS

rules.name: Clear-Site-Data Header Missing on Logout
rules.description: Detects logout responses missing Clear-Site-Data header that should purge cached sensitive data
rules.aql_query: SELECT URL, sourceip FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/logout%' OR URL ILIKE '%/signout%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e2 WHERE e2.correlationid = events.correlationid AND e2.header_name = 'Clear-Site-Data') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Service Worker Registration for Sensitive Pages
rules.description: Detects service worker registration on authentication or payment pages that could intercept sensitive data
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE payload ILIKE '%navigator.serviceWorker.register%' AND (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/payment%' OR URL ILIKE '%/checkout%' OR URL ILIKE '%/account%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: WebRTC Local IP Leakage
rules.description: Detects WebRTC-related requests that may expose local IP addresses through STUN/TURN servers
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%stun:%' OR URL ILIKE '%turn:%' OR URL ILIKE '%stun.%' OR URL ILIKE '%:3478%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_webrtc_service' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Upload Directory Script Execution
rules.description: Detects file upload to directories that allow script execution (PHP, JSP, ASPX) enabling remote code execution
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/uploads/%.php%' OR URL ILIKE '%/uploads/%.jsp%' OR URL ILIKE '%/upload/%.aspx%' OR URL ILIKE '%/files/%.php%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_file_processor' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Log File Encryption Missing - Audit Data Exposure
rules.description: Detects log transmission without encryption, exposing audit data in transit
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, destinationport FROM events WHERE (destinationport = 514 OR destinationport = 5514 OR destinationport = 9200) AND NOT sourceip IN (SELECT sourceip FROM ASSET WHERE type = 'log_shipper_encrypted') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Spring Boot Actuator Heap Dump Exposure
rules.description: Detects access to Spring Boot Actuator heap dump endpoint that exposes memory contents including credentials
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/actuator/heapdump%' OR URL ILIKE '%/actuator/threaddump%') AND NOT sourceip = 'internal_monitoring' LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Identity Token JWT Claim Overexposure
rules.description: Detects JWT tokens in authentication flows containing excessive claims beyond the minimum required (PII, roles, permissions)
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, header_value FROM events WHERE header_name = 'Authorization' AND header_value ILIKE 'Bearer eyJ%' AND (header_value ILIKE '%address%' OR header_value ILIKE '%phone_number%' OR header_value ILIKE '%ssn%' OR header_value ILIKE '%passport%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: OpenID Connect UserInfo Endpoint Data Overexposure
rules.description: Detects excessive data returned from OpenID Connect UserInfo endpoints beyond what is required by the client application
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, LONG(LENGTH(payload)) as response_size FROM events WHERE URL ILIKE '%/userinfo%' AND response_size > 2048 AND NOT sourceip = 'authorized_oidc_client' LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Account Lockout Policy Bypass via Response Timing
rules.description: Detects timing differences in authentication failure responses that reveal account existence or lockout status
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL, LONG(eventduration) as duration FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/login%' OR URL ILIKE '%/auth%') AND payload ILIKE '%failed%' GROUP BY sourceip, URL, duration LAST 1 HOURS HAVING STDDEV(duration) > 200

rules.name: Social Login Scope Over-Privilege
rules.description: Detects OAuth social login flows requesting excessive scopes beyond what is needed for the application
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/auth/google?scope=%' OR URL ILIKE '%/auth/facebook?scope=%' OR URL ILIKE '%/auth/github?scope=%') AND (URL ILIKE '%scope=%full%' OR URL ILIKE '%scope=%admin%' OR URL ILIKE '%scope=%all%') LAST 1 HOURS

rules.name: Identity Data Retention Policy Violation
rules.description: Detects access to identity records past their retention period indicating data retention policy violations
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, username, URL FROM events WHERE (URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/users/%' OR URL ILIKE '%/api/v%/accounts/%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM REFERENCE_SET WHERE type = 'retention_policy') GROUP BY sourceip, username LAST 24 HOURS HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
